_about: List prices in USD per million tokens, used for the cost columns. Add the model you run before running it; a model with no entry stops the run instead of being priced at a guess. Record where each price came from and when. A model priced higher for long prompts has a long_context block, applied per request when that request's prompt (uncached input + cache reads + cache writes) is above the threshold.

claude-haiku-5-5.source: Anthropic model pricing ($0.10 / $0.50 per MTok, $0.50 / $2.50 above 100K prompt tokens). Cache writes priced at 1.25x input (5-minute TTL) and reads at 0.1x, the standard multipliers; the long-context cache rates assume the same multipliers.
